zh: 合法方案只有两类：不修改，或者恰好把某一个元素反号；元素个数只有 10 万，可以全部枚举。
设原总和为 S。把元素 x 反号后，新总和等于 S−2x，不需要重新求和。
先求 S，答案初值为 |S|；遍历每个元素 x，用 |S−2x| 更新最小值；输出最小值。
en: There are only two kinds of valid plans: change nothing, or negate exactly one element; with at most 100000 elements, all of them can be enumerated.
Let S be the original sum. After negating an element x, the new sum is S - 2x, with no need to sum again.
Compute S and start the answer at |S|; for every element x update the minimum with |S - 2x|; print the minimum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First compute the total S; the candidate for changing nothing is |S|. Negating an element x makes the total S - 2x; scan all elements and take the smallest absolute value.

## Correctness

The only valid plans are to change nothing or to negate one chosen index, and the scan enumerates all of them; S - 2x is exactly the total after removing the original x and adding -x. Taking the minimum is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1) apart from the input.
